	protected bool DispatchUiClick(MCPCommand command, MCPResult result)
<<<INSERT
	//! Dispatches a user action by name. Resolves the nearest matching object,
	//! constructs an ActionTarget with a valid cursorHitPos (never vector.Zero,
	//! which fails CCTCursor distance checks on large maps), and calls
	//! PerformActionStart. Returns immediately; server acknowledgment is async.
	protected bool DispatchActionUse(MCPCommand command, MCPResult result)
	{
		if (!command.args || command.args.action == "")
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "bad_args";
			return true;
		}

		PlayerBase player = PlayerBase.Cast(GetGame().GetPlayer());
		if (!player)
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "no_player";
			return true;
		}

		ActionManagerClient amc = ActionManagerClient.Cast(player.GetActionManager());
		if (!amc)
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "no_action_manager";
			return true;
		}

		string actionName = command.args.action;
		ActionBase targetAction = null;
		ref array<ref ActionBase> actionsArray = ActionManagerBase.m_ActionsArray;
		if (actionsArray)
		{
			int i = 0;
			while (i < actionsArray.Count())
			{
				ActionBase candidate = actionsArray.Get(i);
				if (candidate && candidate.Type().ToString() == actionName)
				{
					targetAction = candidate;
					break;
				}
				i = i + 1;
			}
		}

		if (!targetAction)
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "action_not_found";
			return true;
		}

		vector searchCenter;
		if (command.args.pos && command.args.pos.Count() == 3)
		{
			searchCenter = Vector(command.args.pos.Get(0), command.args.pos.Get(1), command.args.pos.Get(2));
		}
		else
		{
			searchCenter = player.GetPosition();
		}

		float searchRadius = 5.0;
		if (command.args.radius > 0.0 && IsFiniteFloat(command.args.radius))
		{
			searchRadius = command.args.radius;
		}

		m_ReadyObjects.Clear();
		m_ReadyProxyCargos.Clear();
		GetGame().GetObjectsAtPosition3D(searchCenter, searchRadius, m_ReadyObjects, m_ReadyProxyCargos);

		Object targetObj = null;
		float minDistSq = float.MAX;
		string filterClass = command.args.classname;
		int j = 0;
		while (j < m_ReadyObjects.Count())
		{
			Object candidateObj = m_ReadyObjects.Get(j);
			if (candidateObj && candidateObj != player)
			{
				if (filterClass == "" || candidateObj.ClassName() == filterClass)
				{
					vector objPos = candidateObj.GetPosition();
					float distSq = vector.DistanceSq(objPos, searchCenter);
					if (distSq < minDistSq)
					{
						minDistSq = distSq;
						targetObj = candidateObj;
					}
				}
			}
			j = j + 1;
		}

		if (!targetObj)
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "target_not_found";
			return true;
		}

		vector cursorHitPos = targetObj.GetPosition();
		ActionTarget actionTarget = new ActionTarget(targetObj, null, -1, cursorHitPos, 0);

		if (amc.GetRunningAction() != null)
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "action_in_progress";
			return true;
		}

		if (!amc.ActionPossibilityCheck(player.GetCurrentCommandID()))
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "not_possible";
			return true;
		}

		if (!ScriptInputUserData.CanStoreInputUserData())
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "input_busy";
			return true;
		}

		if (!targetAction.Can(player, actionTarget, null))
		{
			result.ok = false;
			result.error = "condition_failed";
			return true;
		}

		amc.PerformActionStart(targetAction, actionTarget, null, NULL);

		result.ok = true;
		result.started = true;
		result.action = actionName;
		result.classname = targetObj.ClassName();
		result.pos_real = new array<float>();
		VectorToArray(cursorHitPos, result.pos_real);
		result.distance = vector.Distance(cursorHitPos, player.GetPosition());
		return true;
	}

- Reused existing `m_ReadyObjects` and `m_ReadyProxyCargos` arrays to avoid allocations in the tick path.
